$comment: Contract for the ReassignTcManager server-side command (requirements log row 4). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration). Custom API parameter Type codes: 10=String.

customApi.name: al_ReassignTcManager
customApi.description: Hands one case's remedial action and sign-off to another T&C Manager, in place of the one mapped to its adviser; an empty manager hands it back. Needs the case.reassignmanager capability; writes an Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_outcomecase to hand over.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Why the case is handed over; kept on the audit event.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

requestParameters.name: ManagerId
requestParameters.description: Contact id of the T&C Manager who takes the case. Empty hands it back to the adviser mapping.

responseProperties.name: Summary
responseProperties.description: Who the case moved from and to, as written to the audit event.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.
